newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber SIR20 flat in dull late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber SIR20 flat in dull late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in dull late trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
One Bangka dealer said he last sold February SIR20 at 54.25 fob Singapore last Friday, but the volume was small as the purchase was for short-covering.
Dealers said sellers stayed on the sidelines and refused to lower their offer prices despite the weak demand.
